item.title: Saugus Cafe — From Depot Diner to Santa Clarita Icon
item.description: The Saugus Cafe traces its origins in Santa Clarita to 1888, when the Saugus Train Station was constructed with a dining facility located inside the depot. At that time, the cafe’s operations—including a public dining room and bar, kitchen, pantry, and upstairs hotel rooms—occupied more than half of the station building.
